---
description: fill_in_detail as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: filling in details the world's tables give someone
arguments:
  who: "The person or thing."
  part: "Which part of their detail: money, gear or vehicles; left out, every part."
---
Fills in detail the world's tables give someone or something that nobody has recorded: a person's money (their accounts and what is on them), the everyday things they carry, a vehicle's fuel and wear. Nothing else fills these in. The values are drawn from the tables, not from the story, so each is recorded with the world's defaults as its source and as assumed. The answer says what was made; given as a receipt, it leaves how it now stands to the file it names.
